# DeepSeek-R1 W4A16 Demo

## Summary
Highly optimized local implementation of DeepSeek-R1 using W4A16 quantization (Weights 4-bit / Activations 16-bit). Designed for maximum throughput on mid-range NVIDIA GPUs (RTX 3060 12GB) and optimized for the CachyOS environment.

## Key Technical Specifications
- **Format:** W4A16 (Preserves reasoning CoT while fitting 12GB VRAM)
- **Baseline Performance:** 70+ TPS on RTX 3060 (Solo inference)
- **Speculative Performance:** 130+ TPS (Target: DeepSeek-R1-7B | Draft: Qwen2.5-0.5B)
- **Memory Efficiency:** 84.5% Bus Bandwidth Saturation (Nsight verified)
- **Context Support:** 32k tokens via INT4 KV Cache optimization
- **Infrastructure:** Compatible with Nexus Distributed Cluster (10Gbps/2.5Gbps links)

## Use Cases
- High-speed agentic workflows via OpenClaw
- Localized AI orchestration (Aynine project)
- Hard Science fiction writing and technical research
- Real-time Telegram interaction with TTS/STT (Kokoro-82M integration)
